cases.name: shares
cases.query:
SELECT 地域, AGG(売上高), AGG(選択地域内の売上構成比), AGG(全地域の売上に占める割合)
FROM MODEL
WHERE dt_month = '2025-02-01' AND 地域 = 'North'
GROUP BY 地域
cases.sql:
-- dialect: mssql

/** DML_CALENDAR { pk(dt_date) } **/
/** TABLE_SALES { pk(id) } **/

/*------------------------------------------------------*/
/**                       measure                      **/
/*------------------------------------------------------*/

/** [#DML_売上明細_BY_地_DM_0850CC0] { pk(地域, dt_month) } **/
if object_id(N'tempdb..[#DML_売上明細_BY_地_DM_0850CC0]', N'U') is not null drop table [#DML_売上明細_BY_地_DM_0850CC0];
select
    region as 地域,
    dt_month,
    SUM(amount) as 売上高,
    SUM(SUM(amount)) over (partition by dt_month) as 売上高_minus_dim_地域,
    (SUM(amount)) / nullif(SUM(SUM(amount)) over (partition by dt_month), 0) as [選択地域内の売上構成比]
into [#DML_売上明細_BY_地_DM_0850CC0]
from TABLE_SALES
where dt_month = '2025-02-01'
    and region = 'North'
group by region, dt_month;

create unique clustered index idx__地_dm
	on [#DML_売上明細_BY_地_DM_0850CC0]
	   (地域, dt_month);

/** DML_売上明細_BY_地_DM_C7FCCC0 { pk(地域, dt_month) } **/
with DML_売上明細_BY_地_DM_C7FCCC0 as (
select
    region as 地域,
    dt_month,
    SUM(amount) as 売上高,
    SUM(SUM(amount)) over (partition by dt_month) as 売上高_minus_dim_地域
from TABLE_SALES
where dt_month = '2025-02-01'
group by region, dt_month
),

/** DML_売上明細_BY_地_DM_FA6ACC0 { pk(地域, dt_month) } **/
DML_売上明細_BY_地_DM_FA6ACC0 as (
select
    t.地域,
    t.dt_month,
    t76543.売上高 / nullif(t.売上高_minus_dim_地域, 0) as [全地域の売上に占める割合]
from DML_売上明細_BY_地_DM_C7FCCC0 t
left join [#DML_売上明細_BY_地_DM_0850CC0] t76543 
	on (t76543.地域 = t.地域 or (t76543.地域 is null and t.地域 is null))
	and (t76543.dt_month = t.dt_month or (t76543.dt_month is null and t.dt_month is null))
)


/*-----------------------------------------------------*/
/**                       query                       **/
/*-----------------------------------------------------*/

select
    coalesce(t1.地域, t2.地域) as 地域,
    t1.売上高,
    t1.[選択地域内の売上構成比],
    t2.[全地域の売上に占める割合]
from [#DML_売上明細_BY_地_DM_0850CC0] t1
full outer join DML_売上明細_BY_地_DM_FA6ACC0 t2
    on (t2.地域 = t1.地域 or (t2.地域 is null and t1.地域 is null))
    and (t2.dt_month = t1.dt_month or (t2.dt_month is null and t1.dt_month is null))
where coalesce(t1.地域, t2.地域) = 'North'
order by 地域;

cases.name: grain_avg
cases.query:
SELECT 地域, AGG(一件当たり売上高), AGG(顧客当たり平均売上高)
FROM MODEL
WHERE dt_month = '2025-02-01'
GROUP BY 地域
cases.sql:
-- dialect: mssql


/** TABLE_SALES { pk(id) } **/

/** DML_売上明細_BY_DM_地_C7FCCC0 { pk([地域]) }  **/
with DML_売上明細_BY_DM_地_C7FCCC0 as (
select
	dt_month,
	region as [地域],
	SUM(amount) as [売上高],
	COUNT(1) as [売上件数],
	(SUM(amount)) / nullif(COUNT(1), 0) as [一件当たり売上高]
from TABLE_SALES
where dt_month = '2025-02-01'
group by dt_month,
	region
),

/** DML_売上明細_BY_DM_地_C_C7FCCDB { pk([地域], customer) }  **/
DML_売上明細_BY_DM_地_C_C7FCCDB as (
select
	dt_month,
	region as [地域],
	customer,
	SUM(amount) as [売上高]
from TABLE_SALES
where dt_month = '2025-02-01'
group by dt_month,
	region,
	customer
),

/** DML_売上明細_BY_DM_地_C7FC20F { pk(dt_month, [地域]) }  **/
DML_売上明細_BY_DM_地_C7FC20F as (
select
	dt_month,
	[地域],
	AVG([売上高]) as [顧客当たり平均売上高]
from DML_売上明細_BY_DM_地_C_C7FCCDB
group by dt_month,
	[地域]
)

/** MAIN_QUERY { pk([地域]) } **/
select
	/** auto-generated by datoml: q9b14e06a53 **/
	t.[地域],
	t.[一件当たり売上高],
	t79446.[顧客当たり平均売上高]
from DML_売上明細_BY_DM_地_C7FCCC0 t
left join DML_売上明細_BY_DM_地_C7FC20F t79446 
	on (t79446.dt_month = t.dt_month or (t79446.dt_month is null and t.dt_month is null))
	and (t79446.[地域] = t.[地域] or (t79446.[地域] is null and t.[地域] is null))
order by t.[地域] asc;
